one_line: Teenage Ghadar revolutionary linking Punjabi exile workers and anti-colonial networks across the Pacific, 1913–1915.

appearance.age_look: Looks about 18–19, slim but wiry, with the quiet toughness of a student who also does manual work.
appearance.face: Oval face with a straight nose, warm medium-brown Punjabi complexion, sharp dark eyebrows, deep-set almond eyes with a serious, thoughtful gaze, faint shadow of a moustache, default expression calm and resolute with a hint of youthful idealism.
appearance.hair: Black hair gathered under a neatly tied small dark navy-blue turban in an early 20th-century Punjabi style, modest height, with no ornament; a few loose sideburn strands visible in front of the ears.
appearance.costume: Era-accurate early 1910s ensemble: a long, knee-length off-white cotton kurta with a straight collar and simple buttons, worn over slightly loose, ankle-length light beige salwar; over this a medium-weight, dark charcoal-grey Western-style single-breasted wool coat (three buttons, notched lapels, two flap pockets) reflecting his time in California, and a plain brown leather belt; feet in sturdy brown lace-up leather shoes, and a soft, mid-brown wool shawl folded neatly over one shoulder to signal his Punjabi roots without looking ornate; fabrics are matte, practical and unembroidered, with just a subtle thin vertical stripe weave on the kurta.
appearance.signature: A rolled newspaper bundle of the Ghadar paper tucked under his left arm, its edges slightly worn, and in his right hand a simple steel fountain pen with a dark wooden body and metal clip, symbolising his work as a writer and printer-organizer.

ref_desc: Kartar Singh Sarabha is a slim 18-year-old Punjabi youth with a medium-brown complexion, black hair under a small navy-blue turban, wearing an off-white kurta, light beige salwar, charcoal-grey Western wool coat, brown shoes, a brown shawl, and carrying a rolled Ghadar newspaper and a simple steel fountain pen in a muted off-white, charcoal grey, navy blue, beige and brown palette.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style character model sheet of Kartar Singh Sarabha: a slim 18-year-old Punjabi young man with a medium-brown complexion, oval face, straight nose, sharp dark brows, deep-set determined almond eyes and a faint youthful moustache, his default expression calm, serious and idealistic. His black hair is fully covered by a neatly tied small navy-blue Punjabi turban with no ornament, with just a hint of sideburn hair visible. He wears an early 1910s, historically accurate outfit: a knee-length off-white cotton kurta with straight collar and simple buttons, slightly loose light beige salwar trousers to the ankles, and over them a medium-weight dark charcoal-grey single-breasted wool coat with three buttons, notched lapels and two flap pockets, all cut in a modest Western style, plus a plain brown leather belt. A soft mid-brown wool shawl is folded neatly over one shoulder in a restrained Punjabi manner, and he has sturdy brown lace-up leather shoes. In his left arm he tucks a rolled, slightly worn bundle of newspapers representing the Ghadar paper, and in his right hand he lightly grips a simple steel fountain pen with a dark wooden body and metal clip, posed as if ready to write or organize. Show the character from front, side and back within one frame, keeping all garments modest and fully covering the torso and legs, emphasising the consistent off-white, charcoal grey, navy blue, beige and brown colour palette and the mix of Punjabi kurta-salwar with a Western coat, turban, shawl, newspaper bundle and pen as fixed identifying features.
